# RogueIQ

> Get Smarter About Money. Market tools and verified money news that show where the market stands today, for people and their AI agents. Every claim carries a primary source and date. No buy/sell calls or picks.

RogueIQ provides general education and tools, not personalized investment, tax or legal advice. Data may be delayed or contain errors; check the source before making decisions. Nothing on this site is an offer or solicitation to buy or sell any security.

## The RogueIQ Wire (start here)

Major releases from U.S. government agencies and official sources (Fed, BLS, BEA, Treasury, OFAC, SEC, EDGAR, CFTC, DOJ, Nasdaq halts) as structured data. Free, no auth.

- [Web app](https://rogueiq.com/wire/)
- [MCP server (streamable HTTP, read-only)](https://rogueiq.com/wire/mcp): tools list_items, get_item, get_breakdown, get_calendar, get_heads_up
- [JSON API base](https://rogueiq.com/wire/v1): e.g. /v1/items, /v1/calendar, /v1/breakdown/{id}
- [OpenAPI spec](https://rogueiq.com/wire/openapi.json)
- [Docs](https://rogueiq.com/wire/docs/)
- [Wire llms.txt](https://rogueiq.com/wire/llms.txt)
- [Wire SKILL.md](https://rogueiq.com/wire/SKILL.md)
- [Wire item pages](https://rogueiq.com/wire/sitemap.xml): one page per release at https://rogueiq.com/wire/item/{id}/

## Net worth by age (2025 SCF)

Where a net worth ranks among U.S. families of the same age, from the Federal Reserve's 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances (2025 dollars). Free, no auth.

- [Calculator and tables](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/): median/mean by age (Fed report Table 2) + RogueIQ-computed percentiles, 2025 dollars
- [MCP (streamable HTTP)](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/mcp): tool networth_percentile_by_age
- [API](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/api/v1/networth-by-age?age=35&net_worth=150000) · [OpenAPI](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/api/openapi.json) · [CSV](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/networth-by-age-2025.csv)
- Per-age pages: [Under 35](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/under-35/), [35-44](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/35-44/), [45-54](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/45-54/), [55-64](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/55-64/), [65-74](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/65-74/), [75+](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/75-and-older/)
- [llms.txt](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/api/llms.txt) · [SKILL.md](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/api/SKILL.md)

## Market pulse (end of day, weekly trend)

End-of-day 10Y and 2Y Treasury par yields, the 10s-2s spread, EIA Brent spot and the Fed broad dollar index (H.10), each with 1-week and 1-month change, as-of date and official source. Descriptive weekly read; no forecasts or advice.

- [Market pulse page](https://rogueiq.com/market-pulse/)
- [JSON API](https://rogueiq.com/market-pulse/api/v1/pulse) · [OpenAPI](https://rogueiq.com/market-pulse/api/openapi.json) · [CSV](https://rogueiq.com/market-pulse/pulse-latest.csv)
- MCP: tool get_market_pulse on https://rogueiq.com/wire/mcp

## For agents

- [Agents page](https://rogueiq.com/agents/): every endpoint and a config snippet in one place
